Hi Emma — attaching a draft checklist and SLA summary for procurement. High level items below; full version attached as Redwood_Support_Roster_v1.pdf and SLA_summary_table.csv.

Support & Escalation checklist (summary):
- Primary support channel: support@redwood.ai (ticketing portal + auto-triage)
- Response tiers:
  - P1 (service down): initial response within 15 minutes (24/7), engineering mobilized; target restoration time depends on incident type but we provide continuous updates
  - P2 (degraded but partial functionality): initial response within 1 hour (business hours), escalation to SE as needed
  - P3 (general questions / feature requests): initial response within 1 business day
- Escalation matrix:
  - Level 1: Support agent -> Level 2: On-call SE (pager) -> Level 3: Incident lead (CSM + engineering director)
- On-call & Pager: 24/7 on-call rotation for P1 incidents; contact via PagerDuty (primary) or +1 888-555-0210
- Status & incident reporting: public status page + direct incident notifications to designated contacts via email and SMS

SLA highlights (hosted API):
- Monthly uptime target: 99.9% (standard hosted)
- Dedicated capacity (reserved): 99.95% uptime SLA (available via Dedicated agreements)
- Credits: pro-rated service credits for rolling 3rd-party measured downtime above the SLA threshold (details in formal SLA doc)

Next steps: we'll produce a one-page attachment that you can include with the PO and populate the vendor section of your onboarding form. See attached for the first draft.

Regards,
Monica Patel
